hits.title: AfterQuery becomes Y Combinator's fastest-ever unicorn, now valued at $3.2B
hits.author: andsoitis

hits.title: Programming inside the URL string
hits.story_text: About http://afterquery.appspot.com/, a pure-client-side javascript tool that downloads jsonp-formatted data from a given URL, applies a configurable series of transformations, and then renders the result as either a data table or a Google Visualizations (gviz) chart.
hits.author: emmelaich
